comments.text:
The hover effect here on the mini preview is not what I had in mind. I wanted _just_ the globe to change color on hover; it should get a little darker (more brown, since it should already be a neutral warm gray color). I also thought you could make the satellites pulse some. 

Satellites in this preview should bigger; closer to the size the dots appear in the satellite objects section of the collapsed table.
